description: Make the project consume the RAW `supabase gen types` output of src/types/database.ts so regenerating it never breaks the build again. Remove the hand-appended export block from database.ts, normalize its encoding from UTF-16LE/CRLF to UTF-8, move ALL convenience aliases into a new non-generated sibling barrel src/types/db.ts (which re-exports the generated module plus the aliases), and repoint every consumer import from '@/types/database' (and './database') to the new barrel. Also fix the genuine GlobalRankRow nullable-view shape mismatch at the app mapping boundary (not by editing generated types), and update docs to the regen-safe workflow. This is one coherent unit: the build (`npm run build`) only goes green once all parts land together. The alias set and table/enum mappings are fully enumerated in context.json.
steps: Baseline: `export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"` then from /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen run `npm run build` and confirm it FAILS with the ~40 errors (TS2305 missing-member across many files, plus TS2769/TS2339/TS7006 in rankings). This is the starting state.

Rewrite src/types/database.ts as UTF-8 containing ONLY the raw generator output: everything from `export type Json` through the `} as const` line that closes `export const Constants`, INCLUDING the generator helper types `Tables`, `TablesInsert`, `TablesUpdate`, `Enums`, `CompositeTypes` and the `Constants` const. DROP the hand-appended block (the trailing `export type CourseStatus = ...`, enum aliases, and `*Row` aliases). To do this safely without hand-retyping the large generated shapes: convert the existing file from UTF-16LE to UTF-8 and strip CRLF and the appended block within a SINGLE shell command (note /tmp is not persistent across separate tool calls), e.g.: `iconv -f UTF-16LE -t UTF-8 src/types/database.ts | sed 's/\r$//' | sed -n '1,/^} as const$/p' > /tmp/db.ts && mv /tmp/db.ts src/types/database.ts` executed as one command. Then verify with `file src/types/database.ts` that it reports UTF-8 (ASCII) text (no longer UTF-16/C++), that the first line is `export type Json =` (strip any leftover BOM), and that `grep -c 'export type CourseStatus' src/types/database.ts` returns 0. Do NOT modify any generated type shape.

Create src/types/db.ts as the regen-safe barrel. It must: (a) `export * from './database';` to re-expose Json, Database, Constants, Tables, TablesInsert, TablesUpdate, Enums, CompositeTypes; (b) import type { Database } from './database'; (c) define enum aliases that EXIST as pg enums by deriving from Database['public']['Enums']: AccountStatus->account_status, ContentStatus->content_status, CourseStatus->course_status, CourseVisibility->course_visibility, EnrollmentStatus->enrollment_status, FriendshipStatus->friendship_status, NotificationType->notification_type, QuestionType->question_type, RoomMemberStatus->room_member_status, UserRole->user_role (pattern: `export type CourseStatus = Database['public']['Enums']['course_status'];`); (d) define the two NON-enum aliases as explicit string-literal unions (they are generated as plain `string`, confirmed): `export type CompletionContext = 'course' | 'room';` and `export type PacVisibility = 'members' | 'educator_only' | 'public';`; (e) define all Row aliases as `Database['public']['Tables'][<table>]['Row']`: AnnouncementRow->announcements, AnswerRow->answers, AttemptRow->attempts, CommentRow->comments, CompletionRow->completions, CourseRow->courses, EnrollmentRow->enrollments, FriendshipRow->friendships, LessonRow->lessons, MedalRow->medals, MissionRow->missions, ModuleRow->modules, NotebookPageRow->notebook_pages, NotebookRow->notebooks, NotificationRow->notifications, ProfileRow->profiles, QuestionRow->questions, ReviewRow->reviews, RoomMemberRow->room_members, RoomRow->rooms, UserMedalRow->user_medals. Add a top-of-file doc comment explaining that database.ts is raw-generated and must never be hand-edited; all app-facing aliases live here.

Repoint src/types/domain.ts: change its `} from './database';` import to `} from './db';` (it imports AccountStatus, AnnouncementRow, AttemptRow, CommentRow, CompletionContext, ContentStatus, CourseStatus, CourseVisibility, EnrollmentRow, EnrollmentStatus, FriendshipRow, FriendshipStatus, MedalRow, MissionRow, NotebookPageRow, NotebookRow, NotificationRow, NotificationType, QuestionType, ReviewRow, RoomMemberRow, RoomMemberStatus, UserMedalRow, UserRole). Update the file's doc comment reference to database.ts if it implies aliases live there.

Repoint every remaining consumer that imports from '@/types/database' to '@/types/db'. Files (verified import sites): src/features/auth/AuthProvider.tsx, src/features/courses/create/QuestionConfigEditor.tsx, src/features/courses/create/CreateCoursePage.tsx, src/features/courses/questionConfig.ts, src/features/courses/api.ts, src/features/courses/CourseCard.tsx, src/features/courses/helpers.ts, src/features/crud/api.ts, src/features/dashboard/api.ts, src/features/friends/__tests__/helpers.test.ts, src/features/friends/api.ts, src/features/friends/helpers.ts, src/features/gamification/api.ts, src/features/lesson/api.ts, src/features/lesson/LessonView.tsx, src/features/notebook/api.ts, src/features/notebook/NotebookPage.tsx, src/features/notifications/api.ts, src/features/notifications/helpers.ts, src/features/notifications/NotificationsPage.tsx, src/features/profile/api.ts, src/features/rooms/api.ts, src/features/rooms/RoomDetailPage.tsx, src/features/settings/api.ts. NOTE: src/lib/supabase.ts and src/features/crud/api.ts import only `Database` - repointing them to '@/types/db' is fine (barrel re-exports it) and keeps imports consistent, but leaving them on '@/types/database' also works since Database stays exported there; prefer repointing all to '@/types/db' for a single consistent source. Only change the module specifier string; do not change the imported names.

Verify src/types/supabase-compat.ts NormalizeDatabase still resolves correctly against the new generated Database that now has `__InternalSupabase` and `graphql_public` members. Its NormalizeSchema maps every key and only rewrites Tables/Views, passing others through, so no code change is expected - but CONFIRM by building that supabase client types still resolve (no `never` collapse). If (and only if) the build shows the client resolving to never, adjust the shim minimally; otherwise leave it untouched.

Fix the GlobalRankRow nullable-view mismatch in src/features/rankings/api.ts. The global_ranking VIEW generates all columns nullable (user_id: string|null, username: string|null, display_name: string|null, avatar_url: string|null, xp_global: number|null, level: number|null, streak_count: number|null, position: number|null) but GlobalRankRow requires non-null string/number. Add a small exported pure helper (e.g. `export function mapGlobalRankRow(r: <generated row type>): GlobalRankRow`) that coalesces nullable columns to safe defaults (strings -> '' , numbers -> 0, avatarUrl stays string|null) and use it in the `.map(...)` inside useGlobalRanking's queryFn. Derive the row parameter type from the generated view, e.g. `Database['public']['Views']['global_ranking']['Row']` imported from '@/types/db', so the helper stays faithful to the generated shape. Do NOT edit database.ts to make the view non-nullable. This also resolves the downstream TS2339/TS7006 errors in GlobalRankingPage.tsx (no change needed there once the hook's return type is GlobalRankRow[]).

Add a unit test for the ranking boundary helper at src/features/rankings/__tests__/api.test.ts (follow the vitest pattern used in src/features/friends/__tests__/helpers.test.ts). Cover: a fully-populated row maps through unchanged; a row with null user_id/username/display_name/xp_global/level/streak_count/position coalesces to '' / 0 as designed; avatar_url null stays null. The test must import mapGlobalRankRow (the real helper) so it would fail if the coalescing were removed.

Update docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md section 4 ('Regenerar os tipos TypeScript apos a 0019') to describe the regen-safe workflow: regenerate database.ts RAW with `supabase gen types ... > src/types/database.ts`; database.ts contains only Json + Database + Constants (+ generator helper types) and must NEVER be hand-edited or have exports appended; all app-facing aliases (enum aliases, *Row aliases, CompletionContext, PacVisibility) live in src/types/db.ts, which consumers import from. Note that on Windows/PowerShell `>` produces UTF-16; the file should be saved/committed as UTF-8. Keep the existing note about the NormalizeDatabase shim. Do not use em dashes. Check README.md for any note instructing to regenerate/hand-edit types and update it consistently if present.

Run `npx prettier --write src/types/db.ts src/features/rankings/api.ts src/features/rankings/__tests__/api.test.ts` (and any other files touched) so format:check stays green. Do NOT run prettier on src/types/database.ts if prettier is configured to ignore generated files - check .prettierignore first; if database.ts is not ignored, running prettier on it is acceptable since it only reformats whitespace, not type shapes, but confirm `file` still reports UTF-8 afterward.
acceptance_criteria: src/types/database.ts is UTF-8 (verified via `file`), its first non-BOM line is `export type Json =`, it contains `export type Database`, `export const Constants`, and the generator helpers (Tables/TablesInsert/TablesUpdate/Enums/CompositeTypes), and contains ZERO hand-appended alias exports (`grep -c 'export type CourseStatus' src/types/database.ts` == 0, same for the *Row aliases).

src/types/db.ts exists, re-exports everything from './database', and exports all required aliases: AccountStatus, ContentStatus, CourseStatus, CourseVisibility, EnrollmentStatus, FriendshipStatus, NotificationType, QuestionType, RoomMemberStatus, UserRole, CompletionContext, PacVisibility, and the 21 *Row aliases.
No source file imports convenience aliases from '@/types/database' or './database' anymore (those modules only expose raw generator output); all alias consumers import from '@/types/db' or './db'.
`npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors (all ~40 prior errors resolved).
`npm run test` passes, including the new ranking boundary helper test.
`npm run lint` introduces no new warnings/errors beyond the 6 pre-existing ones in untouched files.
docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md section 4 describes the regen-safe workflow (raw database.ts, aliases in db.ts, UTF-8, never hand-edit) with no em dashes.
verification: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen && npm run build  (must exit 0)
npm run test  (must pass, including new rankings test)
npm run lint  (no new warnings beyond 6 pre-existing)
file src/types/database.ts  (reports UTF-8 / ASCII text, not UTF-16 / C++)
findings: Implemented as planned. database.ts rewritten in a single shell command (iconv UTF-16LE->UTF-8 | strip CRLF | strip BOM | sed through '} as const'); it is now UTF-8/ASCII (`file` still prints the 'C++ source' content heuristic but reports ASCII text, no longer UTF-16), first line `export type Json =`, zero appended aliases. New barrel src/types/db.ts re-exports './database' and defines the 10 enum aliases, CompletionContext/PacVisibility string unions, and all 21 *Row aliases. All 24 consumer import sites repointed from '@/types/database' to '@/types/db' (plus domain.ts './database'->'./db') via sed, changing only the module specifier. DEVIATION 1: the ranking boundary helper mapGlobalRankRow + the GlobalRankRow interface were placed in a NEW pure module src/features/rankings/helpers.ts and re-exported from api.ts, because api.ts imports '@/lib/supabase' which throws at module load without VITE env vars (no test env is configured) - importing it from a test would crash collection the same way other api.ts modules are never unit-tested directly. The test (src/features/rankings/__tests__/helpers.test.ts, following friends/helpers.test.ts) imports the real mapGlobalRankRow from '../helpers'. api.ts still re-exports mapGlobalRankRow and GlobalRankRow so no public surface changed. DEVIATION 2: fixing the imports surfaced a genuine pre-masked type error in src/features/settings/SettingsPage.tsx - profile.notification_preferences is generated as `Json` but PreferencesSection expects `Record<string,boolean>|null|undefined`; narrowed with a cast at the prop boundary (the helper isPreferenceEnabled already tolerates arbitrary records). This error was hidden on baseline because the broken imports collapsed the profile type. Added src/types/database.ts to .prettierignore (generated, must not be reformatted). npm run build exits 0 (was 39 errors on baseline), npm run test 161 passed incl. 3 new ranking tests, npm run lint 6 pre-existing warnings/0 errors (no new), npm run format:check flags only 3 pre-existing untouched files (.agents review.md, supabase/.temp/linked-project.json, supabase/README.md) which were already dirty on baseline. docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md section 4 updated to the regen-safe workflow (raw database.ts, aliases in db.ts, UTF-8, never hand-edit, view-null coalescing at boundary); no em dashes. README only links to that doc, no hand-edit instruction to change.
